Real status and vendor/owner/source-rating filters are retained. This increases vertical density relative to the source, and individual exception actions require scrolling at the reviewed viewports. The header review action remains visible.

The global shell retains the approved teal tokens and existing navigation. At 768px the long actor-chip label truncates in both themes; this is global-shell content outside the selected Issues body, with CRO still visible.
The production header retains distinct vendor-identity and relationship edit actions. At narrow widths labels wrap within the button bounds rather than dropping either command.
The source is light-only. Dark captures assess the same source anatomy using shared dark tokens, not an absent dark source design.
limitations: This bounded AI visual review is not product/design acceptance, a pixel-parity claim or operational sign-off. Whole-screen acceptance remains 0/19.

These are viewport captures. Exception rows and context content below each image boundary are not independently visually assessed by this receipt; interaction and focus evidence are recorded separately.
Synthetic fixture screenshots do not establish live backend authorization, tenant isolation, four-actor execution, production performance or cutover readiness.
Final after/approved-reference copies are byte-identical to the five immutable source-only images directly inspected; path substitution does not represent an additional visual inspection.
No runtime or stylesheet files were changed for this review.
